newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales up 1.3 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales up 1.3 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales rose 1.3 percent in the week ended December 21 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 4.8 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was up 1.4 percent from the prior month.
"Although the pace of sales accelerated over the latest week, sales relative to retailers' plans were a tad below their expectations," a BTM/Schroders report said.
